-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedunion

go 1.27

-- m/member/member.lgo --
package member

type A struct {
	A int `json:"a"`
}
type B struct {
	B int `json:"b"`
}
type Mirror struct {
	A int `json:"a"`
}
type U interface { A | B }
type Ambiguous interface { A | Mirror }

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"logos/rt"
	"example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type Alias = member.U
type H struct {
	Maps []map[string]Alias `json:"maps"`
	Mm map[string][]member.U `json:"mm"`
	Sl [][]member.U `json:"sl"`
	Deep []map[string][][2]member.U `json:"deep"`
	Amb map[string][][]member.Ambiguous `json:"amb"`
}

func main() {
	checkPresentContainers()
	checkRejectedMembers()
	checkNullContainers()
	checkWrongContainerKinds()
	checkNonObjectMaps()
	checkNestedNonObject()
	checkDeepNull()
	fmt.Println("nested unions ok")
}

func checkPresentContainers() {
	const input = `{"maps":[{"x":{"a":1}},{"y":{"b":2}}],"mm":{"x":[{"b":3},{"a":4}]},"sl":[[{"a":5}],[{"b":6}]],"deep":[{"x":[[{"a":7},{"b":8}]]}]}`
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
	checkPresentValues(h)
	// Encoding and a second decode must retain member identity at every depth.
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(h)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	var again H
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &again); err != nil { panic(err) }
	checkPresentValues(again)
}

func checkPresentValues(h H) {
	mapX, ok := h.Maps[0]["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing maps x") }
	checkA(mapX, 1)
	mapY, ok := h.Maps[1]["y"]
	if !ok { panic("missing maps y") }
	checkB(mapY, 2)
	mmX, ok := h.Mm["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing mm x") }
	checkB(mmX[0], 3)
	checkA(mmX[1], 4)
	checkA(h.Sl[0][0], 5)
	checkB(h.Sl[1][0], 6)
	deepX, ok := h.Deep[0]["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing deep x") }
	checkA(deepX[0][0], 7)
	checkB(deepX[0][1], 8)
}

func checkRejectedMembers() {
	for _, input := range []string{
		`{"maps":[{"x":{"z":1}}]}`,
		`{"mm":{"x":[{"z":1}]}}`,
		`{"sl":[[{"z":1}]]}`,
		`{"deep":[{"x":[[{"z":1}]]}]}`,
	} {
		var bad H
		checkError(json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &bad), 0)
	}
	var ambiguous H
	checkError(json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"amb":{"x":[[{"a":1}]]}}`), &ambiguous), 2)
	if ambiguous.Amb != nil { panic("ambiguous map assigned") }
}

func checkNullContainers() {
	var nulls H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"maps":[null,{"x":null}],"mm":{"x":null},"sl":[null,[null]],"deep":[{"x":[null]}]}`), &nulls); err != nil { panic(err) }
	nullMapX, ok := nulls.Maps[1]["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing null maps x") }
	nullMmX, ok := nulls.Mm["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing null mm x") }
	if nulls.Maps[0] != nil || nullMapX != nil || nullMmX != nil || nulls.Sl[0] != nil || nulls.Sl[1][0] != nil { panic("nested null") }
}

func checkWrongContainerKinds() {
	// A skipped wrong-kind descendant must retain its saved scanner error,
	// while still decoding later siblings and later top-level fields.
	for _, input := range []string{
		`{"mm":{"x":42}}`,
		`{"mm":{"x":42,"y":[{"b":21}]},"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`,
		`{"deep":[{"x":42,"y":[[{"a":23},{"b":24}]]}],"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`,
		`{"deep":[{"x":[42,[{"a":23},{"b":24}]]}],"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`,
	} {
		var bad H
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &bad)
		var typeErr *json.UnmarshalTypeError?
		if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &typeErr) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want container type error, got %v", err)) }
		checkContainerProgress(input, bad)
	}
}

func checkContainerProgress(input string, bad H) {
	if strings.Contains(input, `"sl"`) {
		if len(bad.Sl) != 1 || len(bad.Sl[0]) != 1 { panic("lost later field") }
		checkA(bad.Sl[0][0], 22)
	}
	if strings.Contains(input, `"b":21`) {
		y, ok := bad.Mm["y"]
		if !ok || len(y) != 1 { panic("lost map sibling") }
		checkB(y[0], 21)
	}
	if strings.Contains(input, `"a":23`) {
		checkDeepProgress(input, bad)
	}
}

func checkDeepProgress(input string, bad H) {
	key := "y"
	index := 0
	if strings.Contains(input, `"x":[42`) { key = "x"; index = 1 }
	values, ok := bad.Deep[0][key]
	if !ok || len(values) <= index { panic("lost deep sibling") }
	checkA(values[index][0], 23)
	checkB(values[index][1], 24)
}

func wantTypeError(input string) H {
	var bad H
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &bad)
	var typeErr *json.UnmarshalTypeError?
	if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &typeErr) { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want type error, got %v", input, err)) }
	return bad
}

func onlySl(h H) member.U {
	if len(h.Sl) != 1 || len(h.Sl[0]) != 1 { panic("lost later top-level field") }
	return h.Sl[0][0]
}

// A value that is not an object where a map is expected saves one type error
// and decoding continues with later siblings and later top-level fields, as
// encoding/json does.
func checkNonObjectMaps() {
	top := wantTypeError(`{"mm":42,"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`)
	checkA(onlySl(top), 22)
	arr := wantTypeError(`{"mm":[1],"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`)
	checkA(onlySl(arr), 22)
	elem := wantTypeError(`{"maps":[42,{"y":{"b":2}}],"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`)
	if len(elem.Maps) != 2 { panic("lost map element after non-object element") }
	later, ok := elem.Maps[1]["y"]
	if !ok { panic("lost map element sibling") }
	checkB(later, 2)
	checkA(onlySl(elem), 22)
}

func checkNestedNonObject() {
	deep := wantTypeError(`{"deep":[42,{"y":[[{"a":23},{"b":24}]]}],"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`)
	if len(deep.Deep) != 2 { panic("lost deep element after non-object element") }
	pairs, ok := deep.Deep[1]["y"]
	if !ok || len(pairs) != 1 { panic("lost deep sibling") }
	checkA(pairs[0][0], 23)
	checkB(pairs[0][1], 24)
	checkA(onlySl(deep), 22)
	slice := wantTypeError(`{"sl":42,"mm":{"y":[{"b":21}]}}`)
	y, ok := slice.Mm["y"]
	if !ok || len(y) != 1 { panic("lost field after wrong top container") }
	checkB(y[0], 21)
	obj := wantTypeError(`{"maps":{"x":1},"sl":[[{"a":22}]]}`)
	checkA(onlySl(obj), 22)
}

func checkDeepNull() {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"deep":[null,{"x":null},{"y":[null,[{"a":1},null]]}]}`), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
	if len(h.Deep) != 3 || h.Deep[0] != nil { panic("deep null map element") }
	x, ok := h.Deep[1]["x"]
	if !ok || x != nil { panic("deep null slice value") }
	y, ok := h.Deep[2]["y"]
	if !ok || len(y) != 2 { panic("deep y length") }
	if y[0][0] != nil || y[0][1] != nil { panic("deep null array element") }
	checkA(y[1][0], 1)
	if y[1][1] != nil { panic("deep null array member") }
}

func checkA(u member.U, want int) {
	a, ok := u.(member.A)
	if !ok || a.A != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want A(%d), got %#v", want, u)) }
}
func checkB(u member.U, want int) {
	b, ok := u.(member.B)
	if !ok || b.B != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want B(%d), got %#v", want, u)) }
}
func checkError(err error, matched int) {
	var trial rt.UnionTrialError
	if !errors.As(err, &trial) || trial.Matched != matched || trial.Total != 2 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want %d matches, got %v", matched, err)) }
	if len(trial.Members) != 2 { panic("member list") }
	if matched == 2 && (!strings.HasSuffix(trial.Members[0], ".A") || !strings.HasSuffix(trial.Members[1], ".Mirror")) { panic("member declaration order") }
}

-- m/option/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"logos/rt"
	"example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type H struct {
	V (member.U?)? `json:"v"`
}

func check(h H, want int) {
	if want == 0 {
		if h.V != nil { panic("want outer none") }
		return
	}
	if h.V == nil { panic("missing outer option") }
	var absent member.U?
	inner := h.V ?? absent
	if inner == nil { panic("missing inner option") }
	var fallback member.U = member.A{A: -1}
	u := inner ?? fallback
	if want == 1 {
		a, ok := u.(member.A)
		if !ok || a.A != 31 { panic("nested option A") }
	} else {
		b, ok := u.(member.B)
		if !ok || b.B != 32 { panic("nested option B") }
	}
}

func checkNoMember() {
	for _, input := range []string{`{"v":{"z":1}}`, `{"v":42}`} {
		var h H
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h)
		var trial rt.UnionTrialError
		if !errors.As(err, &trial) || trial.Matched != 0 || trial.Total != 2 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want zero-match union error, got %v", input, err)) }
	}
}

func main() {
	checkNoMember()
	for i, input := range []string{`{}`, `{"v":{"a":31}}`, `{"v":{"b":32}}`, `{"v":null}`} {
		want := i
		if i == 3 { want = 0 }
		var h H
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
		check(h, want)
		data, err := json.Marshal(h)
		if err != nil { panic(err) }
		var again H
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &again); err != nil { panic(err) }
		check(again, want)
	}
	fmt.Println("nested option ok")
}

-- m/pointer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"logos/rt"
	"fmt"
	"example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type OptionalUnion = member.U?

type H struct {
	V *(member.U?) `json:"v"`
}

func check(h H, want int) {
	if h.V == nil { panic("missing pointer") }
	inner := *h.V
	if inner == nil { panic("missing pointed option") }
	var fallback member.U = member.A{A: -1}
	u := inner ?? fallback
	if want == 1 {
		a, ok := u.(member.A)
		if !ok || a.A != 41 { panic("pointed option A") }
	} else {
		b, ok := u.(member.B)
		if !ok || b.B != 42 { panic("pointed option B") }
	}
}

func main() {
	checkRequiredPointer()
	checkNoMember()
	for i, input := range []string{`{"v":{"a":41}}`, `{"v":{"b":42}}`} {
		want := i + 1
		h := H{V: new(OptionalUnion)}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
		check(h, want)
		data, err := json.Marshal(h)
		if err != nil { panic(err) }
		again := H{V: new(OptionalUnion)}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &again); err != nil { panic(err) }
		check(again, want)
	}
	fmt.Println("nested pointer ok")
}

func checkRequiredPointer() {
	// SPEC 10.2: an absent or JSON-null non-nil field returns MissingFieldError
	// naming type and field, even when the holder already carries a pointer.
	for _, input := range []string{`{}`, `{"v":null}`} {
		h := H{V: new(OptionalUnion)}
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h)
		var missing rt.MissingFieldError
		if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &missing) || missing.Type != "H" || missing.Field != "V" { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want missing H.V, got %v", err)) }
	}
}

func checkNoMember() {
	for _, input := range []string{`{"v":{"z":1}}`, `{"v":42}`} {
		h := H{V: new(OptionalUnion)}
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h)
		var trial rt.UnionTrialError
		if !errors.As(err, &trial) || trial.Matched != 0 || trial.Total != 2 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want zero-match union error, got %v", input, err)) }
	}
}

-- m/alias/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"logos/rt"
	xs "example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type Optional = (xs.U?)?

type H struct {
	Us  []xs.U              `json:"us"`
	Um  map[string]xs.U     `json:"um"`
	Uss [][]xs.U            `json:"uss"`
	Ua  [2]xs.U             `json:"ua"`
	Umm []map[string][]xs.U `json:"umm"`
	Uo  (xs.U?)?            `json:"uo"`
}

const aliasInput = `{"us":[{"a":1},{"b":2}],"um":{"x":{"a":3},"y":{"b":4}},"uss":[[{"a":5}],[{"b":6}]],"ua":[{"b":7},{"a":8}],"umm":[{"x":[{"a":9},{"b":10}]}],"uo":{"b":11}}`

func main() {
	// The member package is imported as xs: every generated container,
	// option and leaf spelling must use the file's own import name.
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(aliasInput), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
	checkValues(h)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(h)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	var again H
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &again); err != nil { panic(err) }
	checkValues(again)
	checkRejected()
	fmt.Println("nested alias ok")
}

func checkValues(h H) {
	if len(h.Us) != 2 || len(h.Uss) != 2 || len(h.Umm) != 1 { panic("lost alias containers") }
	checkA(h.Us[0], 1)
	checkB(h.Us[1], 2)
	um, ok := h.Um["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing um x") }
	checkA(um, 3)
	um, ok = h.Um["y"]
	if !ok { panic("missing um y") }
	checkB(um, 4)
	checkA(h.Uss[0][0], 5)
	checkB(h.Uss[1][0], 6)
	checkB(h.Ua[0], 7)
	checkA(h.Ua[1], 8)
	umm, ok := h.Umm[0]["x"]
	if !ok || len(umm) != 2 { panic("missing umm x") }
	checkA(umm[0], 9)
	checkB(umm[1], 10)
	checkOption(h.Uo, 11)
}

func checkOption(o Optional, want int) {
	var absent xs.U?
	inner := o ?? absent
	if inner == nil { panic("lost alias option") }
	var fallback xs.U = xs.A{A: -1}
	checkB(inner ?? fallback, want)
}

func checkRejected() {
	for _, input := range []string{
		`{"us":[{"z":1}]}`,
		`{"um":{"x":{"z":1}}}`,
		`{"uss":[[{"z":1}]]}`,
		`{"ua":[{"z":1},{"a":1}]}`,
		`{"umm":[{"x":[{"z":1}]}]}`,
		`{"uo":{"z":1}}`,
	} {
		var h H
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h)
		var trial rt.UnionTrialError
		if !errors.As(err, &trial) || trial.Matched != 0 || trial.Total != 2 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want zero-match union error, got %v", input, err)) }
	}
}

func checkA(u xs.U, want int) {
	a, ok := u.(xs.A)
	if !ok || a.A != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want A(%d), got %#v", want, u)) }
}
func checkB(u xs.U, want int) {
	b, ok := u.(xs.B)
	if !ok || b.B != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want B(%d), got %#v", want, u)) }
}

-- m/named/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"logos/rt"
	"example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type Row []member.U
type Dict map[string]member.U
type Pair [2]member.U
type Key string

type H struct {
	R  Row                `json:"row"`
	Rs []Row              `json:"rows"`
	D  Dict               `json:"dict"`
	Pr Pair               `json:"pair"`
	K  map[Key]member.U   `json:"keyed"`
	G  map[Key][]member.U `json:"grid"`
}

type Pointed struct {
	P *[]member.U `json:"p"`
}

// Options over closed unions are transparent on the wire: none is JSON null
// or an absent key, some is the payload itself.
type Optioned struct {
	S ([]member.U)?          `json:"s"`
	A ([2]member.U)?         `json:"a"`
	M (map[string]member.U)? `json:"m"`
}

const namedInput = `{"row":[{"a":1},{"b":2}],"rows":[[{"b":3}],[{"a":4},{"b":5}]],"dict":{"x":{"a":6},"y":{"b":7}},"pair":[{"b":8},{"a":9}],"keyed":{"x":{"a":10},"y":{"b":11}},"grid":{"g":[{"b":12},{"a":13}]}}`

func main() {
	// Named containers, defined string keys, pointers and options over a
	// container decode union leaves by members, never through an erased value.
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(namedInput), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
	checkNamed(h)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(h)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	var again H
	if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &again); err != nil { panic(err) }
	checkNamed(again)
	checkRejected()
	checkPointed()
	checkOptioned()
	fmt.Println("nested named ok")
}

func checkNamed(h H) {
	if len(h.R) != 2 || len(h.Rs) != 2 || len(h.Rs[1]) != 2 { panic("lost named slices") }
	checkA(h.R[0], 1)
	checkB(h.R[1], 2)
	checkB(h.Rs[0][0], 3)
	checkA(h.Rs[1][0], 4)
	checkB(h.Rs[1][1], 5)
	dx, ok := h.D["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing dict x") }
	checkA(dx, 6)
	dy, ok := h.D["y"]
	if !ok { panic("missing dict y") }
	checkB(dy, 7)
	checkB(h.Pr[0], 8)
	checkA(h.Pr[1], 9)
	kx, ok := h.K[Key("x")]
	if !ok { panic("missing keyed x") }
	checkA(kx, 10)
	ky, ok := h.K[Key("y")]
	if !ok { panic("missing keyed y") }
	checkB(ky, 11)
	g, ok := h.G[Key("g")]
	if !ok || len(g) != 2 { panic("lost keyed grid") }
	checkB(g[0], 12)
	checkA(g[1], 13)
}

func wantNoMember(input string, into any) {
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), into)
	var trial rt.UnionTrialError
	if !errors.As(err, &trial) || trial.Matched != 0 || trial.Total != 2 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want zero-match union error, got %v", input, err)) }
}

func checkRejected() {
	for _, input := range []string{
		`{"row":[{"z":1}]}`,
		`{"rows":[[{"z":1}]]}`,
		`{"dict":{"x":{"z":1}}}`,
		`{"pair":[{"z":1},{"a":1}]}`,
		`{"keyed":{"x":{"z":1}}}`,
		`{"grid":{"g":[{"z":1}]}}`,
	} {
		var h H
		wantNoMember(input, &h)
	}
	p := Pointed{P: new([]member.U)}
	wantNoMember(`{"p":[{"z":1}]}`, &p)
	for _, input := range []string{`{"s":[{"z":1}]}`, `{"a":[{"z":1},{"a":1}]}`, `{"m":{"x":{"z":1}}}`} {
		var o Optioned
		wantNoMember(input, &o)
	}
}

func checkPointed() {
	p := Pointed{P: new([]member.U)}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"p":[{"a":1},{"b":2}]}`), &p); err != nil { panic(err) }
	if len(*p.P) != 2 { panic("lost pointed slice") }
	checkA((*p.P)[0], 1)
	checkB((*p.P)[1], 2)
	for _, input := range []string{`{}`, `{"p":null}`} {
		q := Pointed{P: new([]member.U)}
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &q)
		var missing rt.MissingFieldError
		if err == nil || !errors.As(err, &missing) || missing.Type != "Pointed" || missing.Field != "P" { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want missing Pointed.P for %s, got %v", input, err)) }
	}
}

func checkOptioned() {
	var o Optioned
	input := `{"s":[{"a":1},{"b":2}],"a":[{"b":3},{"a":4}],"m":{"x":{"a":5},"y":{"b":6}}}`
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &o); err != nil { panic(err) }
	if o.S == nil || o.A == nil || o.M == nil { panic("lost option over container") }
	var noS []member.U
	var noA [2]member.U
	var noM map[string]member.U
	s := o.S ?? noS
	a := o.A ?? noA
	m := o.M ?? noM
	if len(s) != 2 || len(m) != 2 { panic("lost option payload") }
	checkA(s[0], 1)
	checkB(s[1], 2)
	checkB(a[0], 3)
	checkA(a[1], 4)
	mx, ok := m["x"]
	if !ok { panic("missing option map x") }
	checkA(mx, 5)
	my, ok := m["y"]
	if !ok { panic("missing option map y") }
	checkB(my, 6)
	checkNone(`{}`)
	checkNone(`{"s":null,"a":null,"m":null}`)
}

func checkNone(input string) {
	var o Optioned
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &o); err != nil { panic(err) }
	if o.S != nil || o.A != nil || o.M != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want none", input)) }
}

func checkA(u member.U, want int) {
	a, ok := u.(member.A)
	if !ok || a.A != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want A(%d), got %#v", want, u)) }
}
func checkB(u member.U, want int) {
	b, ok := u.(member.B)
	if !ok || b.B != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want B(%d), got %#v", want, u)) }
}

-- m/wrapped/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"logos/rt"
	"example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type Mid = (member.U?)?

type H struct {
	V ((member.U?)?)? `json:"v"`
}

// Every layer of a triple option must hold the decoded member: Some(None) at
// any layer is a decode fault.
func payload(h H) member.U {
	var none2 Mid
	var none1 member.U?
	mid := h.V ?? none2
	if mid == nil { panic("lost outer option") }
	inner := mid ?? none1
	if inner == nil { panic("lost middle option") }
	var fallback member.U = member.A{A: -1}
	return inner ?? fallback
}

func check(h H, want int) {
	if want == 0 {
		if h.V != nil { panic("want outer none") }
		return
	}
	if h.V == nil { panic("missing outer option") }
	u := payload(h)
	if want == 1 {
		a, ok := u.(member.A)
		if !ok || a.A != 51 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want A(51), got %#v", u)) }
	} else {
		b, ok := u.(member.B)
		if !ok || b.B != 52 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("want B(52), got %#v", u)) }
	}
}

func checkNoMember() {
	for _, input := range []string{`{"v":{"z":1}}`, `{"v":42}`} {
		var h H
		err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h)
		var trial rt.UnionTrialError
		if !errors.As(err, &trial) || trial.Matched != 0 || trial.Total != 2 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: want zero-match union error, got %v", input, err)) }
	}
}

func main() {
	for i, input := range []string{`{}`, `{"v":{"a":51}}`, `{"v":{"b":52}}`, `{"v":null}`} {
		want := i
		if i == 3 { want = 0 }
		var h H
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(input), &h); err != nil { panic(err) }
		check(h, want)
		data, err := json.Marshal(h)
		if err != nil { panic(err) }
		var again H
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &again); err != nil { panic(err) }
		check(again, want)
	}
	checkNoMember()
	fmt.Println("nested wrapped ok")
}

-- m/shapes/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"example.com/nestedunion/member"
)

type Cell = (member.U?)?

// Options over closed-union containers (OS, OA, OM) and containers of options
// (ES, EA, EM) are transparent on the wire: none is null, some is the payload,
// map keys are sorted, and the independent literals below are the oracle in
// both directions.
type Shapes struct {
	OS ([]member.U)?             `json:"os"`
	OA ([2]member.U)?            `json:"oa"`
	OM (map[string]member.U)?    `json:"om"`
	ES []((member.U?)?)          `json:"es"`
	EA [2]((member.U?)?)         `json:"ea"`
	EM map[string]((member.U?)?) `json:"em"`
}

func memA(n int) member.U { return member.A{A: n} }
func memB(n int) member.U { return member.B{B: n} }

func some(u member.U) Cell {
	var inner member.U? = u
	return inner
}

func none() Cell {
	var c Cell
	return c
}

func fullShapes() Shapes {
	return Shapes{
		OS: []member.U{memA(1), memB(2)},
		OA: [2]member.U{memA(3), memB(4)},
		OM: map[string]member.U{"f": memA(5), "c": memB(6), "e": memA(7), "a": memB(8), "d": memA(9), "b": memB(10)},
		ES: []((member.U?)?){some(memA(11)), none(), some(memB(12))},
		EA: [2]((member.U?)?){none(), some(memA(13))},
		EM: map[string]((member.U?)?){"f": some(memA(14)), "c": none(), "e": some(memB(15)), "a": some(memA(16)), "d": none(), "b": some(memB(17))},
	}
}

func emptyShapes() Shapes {
	return Shapes{
		OS: []member.U{},
		OM: map[string]member.U{},
		ES: []((member.U?)?){},
		EM: map[string]((member.U?)?){},
	}
}

const fullWire = `{"os":[{"a":1},{"b":2}],"oa":[{"a":3},{"b":4}],"om":{"a":{"b":8},"b":{"b":10},"c":{"b":6},"d":{"a":9},"e":{"a":7},"f":{"a":5}},"es":[{"a":11},null,{"b":12}],"ea":[null,{"a":13}],"em":{"a":{"a":16},"b":{"b":17},"c":null,"d":null,"e":{"b":15},"f":{"a":14}}}`
const emptyWire = `{"os":[],"oa":null,"om":{},"es":[],"ea":[null,null],"em":{}}`
const noneWire = `{"os":null,"oa":null,"om":null,"es":null,"ea":[null,null],"em":null}`

func checkWire(name string, v Shapes, want string) {
	got, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	if string(got) != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: marshal\n got %s\nwant %s", name, got, want)) }
	var back Shapes
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(want), &back); err != nil { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: decode: %v", name, err)) }
	again, err := json.Marshal(back)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
	if string(again) != want { panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: remarshal\n got %s\nwant %s", name, again, want)) }
}

func main() {
	checkWire("full", fullShapes(), fullWire)
	checkWire("empty", emptyShapes(), emptyWire)
	checkWire("none", Shapes{}, noneWire)
	fmt.Println("nested shapes ok")
}
